name: Alternate recall and review
short_description: Alternate recall and review once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can alternate recall and review in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Alternate recall and review means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Alternate recall and review in a fresh real-life scenario.

builds_on.note: Recall a five-step sequence helps develop alternate recall and review but is not indispensable.
Recall ten associated items helps develop alternate recall and review but is not indispensable.
Ask for a location in another language helps develop alternate recall and review but is not indispensable.
Exchange greetings in another language helps develop alternate recall and review but is not indispensable.
Give a two-step spoken direction helps develop alternate recall and review but is not indispensable.
